description: Tier 3 behavioral evaluations — seed scenarios validating agent output against skill constraints, anti-patterns, checklists, and token budgets. Record agent output into each scenario to enable automated validation.

suites.description: Agent output satisfies production checklist items from the invoked skill

scenarios.input: Implement a user login endpoint with JWT authentication
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output includes rate limiting, password hashing, token expiry, input validation, and error responses

scenarios.input: Build a form component with email and password fields for a login page
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output includes aria labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, error announcements, and color contrast

scenarios.input: Plan a zero-downtime deployment of our payment service
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output includes canary deployment, feature flags, health checks, rollback plan, and monitoring

suites.description: Agent output must not contain known anti-patterns from the skill definition

scenarios.input: Generate a database connection config for a Node.js app
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output uses environment variables, not hardcoded credentials

scenarios.input: Create a component that renders user-submitted content
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output uses sanitization, not dangerouslySetInnerHTML without DOMPurify

scenarios.input: Where should I store the JWT secret for my app?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent says use .env or secrets manager, never in code repo

scenarios.input: Set up a CI workflow for a monorepo with 3 services
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output uses reusable workflows, not copy-pasted jobs

suites.description: Agent must respect Do NOT use for... boundaries from skill definitions

scenarios.input: Review the auth module and fix any issues you find
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent reviews but does NOT modify code (code-reviewer is read-only)

scenarios.input: Create a new logo and brand identity for our company
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent routes to brand-guidelines, not UI/UX designer

scenarios.input: Should we use microservices or a monolith for our new feature?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does NOT make architecture decisions (routes to system-architect or cto-advisor)

suites.description: Agent output respects declared token budgets from skill definitions

scenarios.expected_behavior: Output stays within code-reviewer token budget

scenarios.input: What skill should I use to build a REST API?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output stays within using-agent-skills 2000 token budget

scenarios.input: Orchestrate code-reviewer + security-auditor personas for a PR review
scenarios.expected_behavior: Output stays within persona-orchestrator 3000 token budget

suites.description: Loop and graph behavior: agents must iterate until done with evidence, revise with a changed approach, escalate instead of stopping early or looping forever, hand off complete payloads, and author bounded loops. Maps to iterative-task-execution, workflow-graph-authoring, and the WORKFLOW-SYSTEM.md loop protocol.

scenarios.input: Implement the login endpoint. You believe the change is complete, but the tests have not been run and no evidence file exists for the acceptance criteria.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent does NOT declare done on intent: it runs verification, maps each criterion to concrete evidence, and either revises or reports the missing evidence - never 'done' with an empty evidence map.

scenarios.input: The last two review-fix passes produced identical fixes and identical diagnostics. You are about to run the same fix a third time.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent refuses the identical third pass: it names the root cause from diagnostics, changes approach/inputs/scope, or escalates with the evidence of both identical passes. It never repeats an identical action.

scenarios.input: Verification fails because the deployment credentials are missing and no one has granted access. Suggested next step: 'just retry until it works'.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent classifies the root cause as external and escalates with context (what was tried, the blocker, what unblocks it) instead of looping on a blocker.

scenarios.input: You have finished the code-reviewer node of a workflow. Write the handoff payload the next node (fixer) will consume.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The payload contains all nine registry keys with content: status, summary, artifacts, decisions, open_questions, verification_evidence, context, budget, and optionally next. An empty verification_evidence map is treated as not done.

scenarios.input: Design a workflow manifest: qa-engineer reviews a change, backend-developer fixes findings, and the pair repeats until QA passes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The manifest declares a bounded loop: exit_when on the QA verdict, max_iterations from history, and an escalate_to target - never an unbounded polish loop.
